sources.snippet: Sentiment Analysis SST-5 This repository contains an LSTM model implemented by PyTorch to perform sentiment classification on the Stanford Sentiment Treebank (SST-5) dataset. We train the model with/without pretrained embeddings and conduct several experiments on different hyperparameters.

sources.snippet: 该数据集是Stanford Sentiment Treebank (SST-5)，用于情感分析任务，包含句子和对应的情感标签。项目提供了一个基于PyTorch的LSTM模型实现，支持使用预训练嵌入进行训练，并包含改进版本的模型以利用更详细的情感标签信息。
